answer: Because the trellis index resolves every citation against the violet checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the saffron audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 286 aliases therefore forfeits the authoring cost 286 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A farm of 4946 identities would post 842 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
